title: Turtle HUD
description: This project replaces hearts, hunger bars, and more with turtles!
body:
# Turtle HUD
Do you like turtles? Well, I do too! So, I made this mod to make Minecraft filled to the brim with turtles no matter where you look.

**This mod changes:**
- All heart textures
- All hunger bar textures
- All suffocating/drowning bubble textures
- The anvil overlay texture
- Accessibility settings icon

Now, turtles are everywhere! How amazing!

![New Heart Textures](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/GIMP9trg/images/257feaaf2d49256eed66dfc75618d1b66636726f.png)

**If you enjoyed this mod, please also check out [Turtle Totems](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/turtle-totems).**
